scheme_name: Aatmanirbhar Gujarat Scheme for Assistance to Mega Industries: Net SGST reimbursement
other_conditions: Minimum investment of INR 2,500 crore in plant and machinery required
Must provide direct employment to at least 2,500 persons
Unit must belong to one of the thrust sectors as defined in the Guidelines
Separate GST registration must be obtained for the eligible products
Project must be a new industrial undertaking with commercial production started within the applicable period
Must comply with conditions regarding sales classifications and documentation
benefits_summary: Full reimbursement of net SGST paid, up to 0.9% of eFCl value per annum, for up to 20 years
